study_design: Clinic-based case-control study comparing histologically confirmed prostate cancer patients with men in whom prostate carcinoma was histologically excluded.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: In a case-control study 192 patients with histologically confirmed prostate cancer were compared with 210 men in whom carcinoma of the prostate had been histologically excluded.
reason: The abstract evaluates prostate cancer overall and does not analyze an aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: There were no differences between patients and controls in self-reported occupational exposures or the consumption of alcohol or smoking.
estimate_classifications.reason: The alcohol result compares prostate cancer cases with controls and has no aggressive-disease qualifier.
